clips.title: The story
paras: Kreldig Ungor gives you Leftwitch's package and sends you back to Ironforge. Roetten Stonehammer is the one to see about your pay, and Kreldig promises a kind word about you once back home.

Kreldig says your pay waits in Ironforge with Roetten Stonehammer himself. Roetten will be glad to be rid of Leftwitch's package, and handing it over should be enough to get what you are owed. Kreldig expects to be in Desolace only a little longer, and still means to speak well of you once home.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: To get paid, you're gonna have to get back to Ironforge and speak to Roetten himself. He'll love getting Leftwitch's package out of the way anyway. Just give him this and it should be enough to get your booty.
And don't worry, I'm still going to put in a good word for you when I get back. I shouldn't be in Desolace much longer.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Well met, friend. Business is booming, the sounds of anvils being struck rings throughout Ironforge, the bellows blow the fires hot, and me wife's making me a pie for dessert after tonight's dinner. Could life be any grander?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah, the package for Leftwitch from Desolace. Excellent. I 'preciate the work, and your timeliness, adventurer. Glad to have you aboard for at least this small bit of work.
I got your payment right here. Let it be known that Reclaimers Inc. Always pays well for a hard week's work.
